_meta.purpose: BCI concept definitions — generated from real BCI fields for classification + generation

schema.classification: NOUN | VERB | ADJ | ADV | PRONOUN | PREP | CONJ | DET | PARTICLE
schema.subclass: animal | food | transport | object | place | person | emotion | action | body_part | communication | medical | time | quantity | abstract
schema.semantic_field: nature | food | transport | objects | social | family | emotion | body | communication | medical | daily_living | academic | time | space | quantity
schema.is: 5-8 words defining what this concept means — used as CLIP text anchor and generation seed
schema.isNot: 5-8 words listing wrong meanings, confusions, homophones — used as CLIP rejection filter and negative prompt
schema.visual: what a correct image shows — used for CLIP matching AND image generation prompt
schema.polysemy_sense: which specific meaning this BCI entry represents
schema.clip_viable: whether visual matching is useful for this concept
schema.generation_strategy: PICTOGRAM | SCENE | SYMBOL | COMPOSITE | ICON | SKIP
schema.us_word: US English word if different from primary (e.g. airplane)
schema.uk_word: UK English word if different from primary (e.g. aeroplane)
schema.spelling_note: which regional variant the BCI primary gloss uses
